title: ChemInform Abstract: LAYERED COMPOUNDS. XXXIV. MOLECULAR AND CRYSTAL STRUCTURE OF A POLYCYCLIC COMPOUND FROM NOVEL CYCLOADDITION REACTION OF TRIPLE‐LAYERED ANTHRACENOPHANE
